description: The Stress Profile Generator's profile for ONE beam element: from CIVIL NX's beam forces and the true section outline it calculates σx (or σx from N / My / Mz, τ from Vz / Vy, von Mises, principal, Tresca) over the section at the chosen positions and loads, and checks every profile against CIVIL NX's own published stresses (effective PSC sections are drawn through CIVIL NX's stress points; composite sections part by part from CIVIL NX's per-part results; envelopes give CIVIL NX's values at the stress points plus the governing member or static part as a profile). Returns per profile: status (ok/unchecked/points/refused) with reasons, forces, extremes and where they occur, CIVIL NX vs calculated at stress points 1–4, per-part σx for composites, and min/max across the section at each depth. With `thermal` it gives the EN 1991-1-5 temperature stresses instead, split into total, restraint, self-equilibrating, uniform and linear parts (Type 3 heating/cooling with 100 mm surfacing, a user ΔT profile, or CIVIL NX's own section temperature; restraint free, full, axial, rotation, or CIVIL NX's forces of a load). Optional csv gives the plugin's CSV export as a download link. Read-only.

csv.description: Also return the plugin's CSV export of every profile (a download link).

depthLevels.description: Levels of the through-depth table (vertex levels are added); 0 leaves it out.

loads.description: Load case / combination / envelope names as stress_element_loads lists them; with stage, that stage's results (e.g. Summation, Dead Load).

positions.description: Positions along the element: I-end, ¼, ½, ¾ span, J-end. Default ["2/4"].

result.description: sx σx combined; sxN/sxMy/sxMz its parts; tVz/tVy shear; vm von Mises; s1/s2 principal; tmax; tresca.

sectionProperties.description: effective = CIVIL NX's own stresses (as the plugin's default); gross = the plugin's calculation on the section as modelled, difference stated.

stage.description: Construction stage: use its results (last step) instead of the final state.

thermal.description: Temperature stresses instead of load results (EN 1991-1-5 §6.1.4).

E.description: E of the element's material, kN/m², if the model's is not to be used.

alphas.description: α per section part, 1/°C (null = from the model). Composite-General parts have none in the model and need it.

components.description: Default all: tTot total, tRes restraint, teig self-equilibrating, tUni uniform (fully restrained), tLin linear (fully restrained).

load.description: CIVIL NX static load case / combination for preset civil or restraint civil.

points.description: preset user: [depth below the top m, ΔT °C] pairs, linear between, zero outside.

preset.description: Type 3 heating / cooling (Table B.3, 100 mm surfacing — check the National Annex), user points, or CIVIL NX's own section/element temperature of thermal.load.

restraint.description: free (statically determinate), full, axial only, rotation only, or CIVIL NX's beam forces of thermal.load.

unit.description: Stress unit of the results (internally kN/m²).

name: stress_profile
title: Stress distribution through a beam section (Stress Profile Generator)
